title: Group Fairness: Independence Revisited
benchmark_measurement: The paper uses a hypothetical example to measure the potential for undesirable outcomes when applying the 'independence' fairness metric, specifically illustrating how it could lead to incarcerating innocent Muslims to equalize parole rates with Christians.
findings: The paper uses a critical example involving religious groups to argue that the 'independence' fairness criterion can lead to highly undesirable and morally wrong decisions. Specifically, it notes that to satisfy this criterion, one might have to incarcerate Muslims who pose no public safety risk simply to ensure that the same proportions of Muslims and Christians are released on parole.
